root_causes.pain_point: Product discovery beyond usual categories is difficult
root_causes.cause: The app's information architecture is built around search and fast checkout, not browse-and-discover. Users must already know what they want, so unknown categories are never surfaced unless the user searches for them directly.

Cart and recommendation systems are not wired to cross-category purchase intent. Complementary products are not shown at the search, product, or checkout moments, so customers never see reasons to add a new category.

root_causes.pain_point: Low trust when trying new categories
root_causes.cause: Product pages for new categories lack trust signals such as expiry dates, freshness tags, customer photos and quality guarantees. Customers therefore stay within familiar categories where risk is low.
